name: severance-pilot
description: Varsiko Agent 4. Executes one signed, human-approved migration mandate: provisions a server, installs Coolify, loads environment variables, deploys, then halts for audit. Decides nothing; holds no provider credentials.

skills.name: Start a migration run
skills.description: Accepts a signed mandate of either kind, verifies it, claims the nonce write-ahead, and returns a run_id immediately. An automated mandate (provider hetzner) buys the server itself. A handoff mandate (provider handoff) buys nothing: the run parks until a human operator has bought the server and registered its IP. Does not block: the flow guard kills any call at 120s, and a full migration takes 3-6 minutes.

skills.name: Poll a migration run
skills.description: Returns current step, state, committed cost, and the next owner. Callers poll this until state is DEPLOYED, FAILED or ROLLED_BACK. A handoff run can report AWAITING_HUMAN_PURCHASE: that is a parked run, not a failure, and next_owner says who must act. It ends in FAILED (EXPIRED) if nobody registers a server before the mandate expires. Each poll performs exactly one advance() so Nasiko can mint a fresh delegation token.

skills.name: Cut over DNS
skills.description: Points the domain at the new server. Requires an Auditor pass token AND passes through an ask-stance tool, so a human approves in Nasiko before it executes.
examples: Auditor passed with token apt_44. Cut over.

skills.name: Route VPS candidates
skills.description: Sorts Broker (Agent 2) VPS candidates into automated, handoff, or unsupported. Treats every scraped field as untrusted text.

_notes.handoff: The operator tools handoff_prepare and handoff_register are not reachable by this agent by design; see tool-rules.json.
